name: comp-505
title: Calendar Time Slot Picker
description: A bordered panel splits a month calendar from a narrow slot list. The right side names the chosen weekday and date above a scrollable stack of half-hour times, some greyed out, which fill white when picked.
use: Someone books a slot on a chosen day and taken times must look clearly unavailable.
avoid: The slot list is mock data that never changes with the day, so real availability means replacing the source.
a11y: Days and slots are keyboard buttons with visible text, but disabled slots only dim and never say why they cannot be booked. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small black panel divided in two: on the left a month grid with weekday initials and white day numbers, on the right a column headed by a weekday and date, then six visible small outlined buttons stacked tight with a few dimmed.
behaves: Pressing a day circles it white, updates the weekday heading and clears any chosen time. Clicking an enabled slot fills it solid white while disabled slots stay dim and unclickable; the slot list itself scrolls.
customise: The eighteen time slots, their availability flags and the caption link are written in the file; real availability or a different date format means editing the source.
weight: light: One month grid and a short list of time buttons; nothing animates.
demo: November 2026 with day 26 and 10:30 picked; half-hour slots from 09:00, several greyed out.
issues: Every date shows the same slots, so picking a new day leaves availability unchanged.
Only about six of the eighteen slots fit before the list must scroll.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of the picker.
polishWhy: Crisp two-pane picker with clear slot states; a fixed slot list and cramped scrolling.
